verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 37.32
3. Balavagga
Ṭhānasutta
“Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, ṭhānāni dullabhāni akatapuññena mātugāmena.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are five things that are hard to get for ladies who have not made merit.

verses.pali: Katamāni pañca?
Patirūpe kule jāyeyyanti—
verses.english: ‘May I be born into a suitable family!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gaccheyyanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born in a suitable family, may I marry into a suitable family!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā, patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā, asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvaseyyanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born in a suitable family and married into a suitable family, may I live at home without a co-wife!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā, patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā, asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born in a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, may I have children!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, catutthaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā, patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā, asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikaṁ abhibhuyya vatteyyanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born in a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, and having had children, may I live having mastered my husband!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṁ ṭhānaṁ dullabhaṁ akatapuññena mātugāmena.
Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca ṭhānāni dullabhāni akatapuññena mātugāmenāti.
verses.english: These are the five things that are hard to get for ladies who have not made merit.

verses.pali: Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, ṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmena.
verses.english: There are five things that are easy to get for ladies who have made merit.

verses.pali: Katamāni pañca?
Patirūpe kule jāyeyyanti—
verses.english: ‘May I be born into a suitable family!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, paṭhamaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gaccheyyanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born into a suitable family, may I marry into a suitable family!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, dutiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvaseyyanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born into a suitable family and married into a suitable family, may I live at home without a co-wife!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, tatiyaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born into a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, may I have children!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, catutthaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṁ kulaṁ gantvā asapatti agāraṁ ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikaṁ abhibhuyya vatteyyanti—
verses.english: ‘Having been born into a suitable family, and married into a suitable family, and living at home without a co-wife, and having had children, may I live having mastered my husband!’

verses.pali: idaṁ, bhikkhave, pañcamaṁ ṭhānaṁ sulabhaṁ katapuññena mātugāmena.
Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca ṭhānāni sulabhāni katapuññena mātugāmenā”ti.
verses.english: These are the five things that are easy to get for ladies who have made merit.”

verses.pali: Aṭṭhamaṁ.
